resources.string: When online, ask GitHub once a day whether a newer MeshLive has been published. GitHub sees your IP address; nothing else about you is sent. Nothing is downloaded or installed until you tap.
Tell me about newer versions nearby

When two phones connect, each tells the other which MeshLive release it runs, in the signed greeting they already exchange (never in what a phone broadcasts). If a connected phone has a newer one you see a quiet note on the home screen; nothing is downloaded or installed. Turning this off also stops your phone from telling others its release.
Newer version nearby (release %1$d). Tap to see how to get it.

MeshLive can ask GitHub once a day, while you are online, whether a newer version has been published.

GitHub then sees your phone's internet address and that it asked about MeshLive. Nothing else about you is sent.

Nothing is downloaded until you tap, and nothing is installed without your confirmation. You can change this any time in Settings.
